title: Optimal local oscillators for the homodyne detection of multiphoton states
summary: We propose a framework for optimizing pulsed local oscillators (LO) for homodyne detection of multiphoton-number states by exploiting the tensor structure of their joint-spectral amplitude (JSA). We show that finding the optimal LO is equivalent to computing the JSA tensor's leading unitary eigenpair and that the factor matrices of the JSA's Tucker higher-order singular value decomposition (HOSVD) coincide with the Schmidt modes of the photon number state's single-particle reduced density matrix.
